description: Evolution quotidienne des stocks de GNL des principaux terminaux méthaniers en France is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données présente la quantité de Gaz Naturel Liquéfié (GNL) stockée en fin de journée gazière (à 6h du matin) dans les terminaux méthaniers français (en m3 GNL et en GWh à 0°). Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Stockage. Its keywords are GNL. The portal shows 2019-10-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
